source_title: AMD Launches 5th Gen AMD EPYC CPUs, Maintaining Leadership Performance and Features for the Modern Data Center
platform_compatibility_visible_text: compatible with the broadly deployed SP5 platform
ddr5_channel_visible_text: 12 channels of DDR5 memory per CPU
researcher_paraphrase: AMD's October 2024 Turin launch establishes a concrete fifth-generation server CPU platform event and a platform-level DDR5 interface requirement while retaining SP5 compatibility.
precision_guard: A CPU launch and its supported memory channels are platform specifications, not measurements of server shipments, DIMM capacity per deployed server, DRAM bit demand, SSD demand or hyperscaler procurement.
authority_boundary: The short preserved phrases are AMD's own product-launch wording. Research annotations do not turn platform capability into market adoption.
